metadata.audit_scope: Full re-audit covering ADVI_REBORN, ADVI_PROFIL, ADVI_PROFAU, ADVI_OFFICE W1-W4 (portal DEV). Previous audit: 2026-03-16.

files.file: Main page component (v5). Partner AUA analytics dashboard with firm selector (firmOverride prop + URL param), 3-tab layout (Distribution, Advisors, Books), PartnerAnalytics header panel, ErrorBoundary per tab. Fetches getPlatinumPartnerAnalytics() at page level and passes down as prop.
Barrel export for AdvisorIntelligence component.

Comprehensive type definitions (v4+). Partner/Firm types, NNA metrics, time series, snapshot, filters, client growth, tax breakdown, header metrics, partner analytics with nested drill-down and time machine, cumulative charts (legacy + platinum), leaderboard (LeaderboardEntry, PlatinumLeaderboardEntry with role_breakdown per-role AUA/NNA/fee), employee leaderboard, advisor book, rolling flows, PartnerAnalyticsResponse (views: aua/nna/geo/adv/ofc), Books types (BooksClientDetailResponse, BooksTimeseriesResponse, BooksCompositionResponse, MixItem, ConcentrationItem), Addendum A types (MixAssetClass, MixTimeseriesPoint, ConcentrationPoint, ConcentrationResponse, MixWindow), PlatinumLeaderboardResponse, PlatinumRoleBreakdown, FeeEfficiencyResponse, AdvisorDrilldownSummary, AdvisorTimeseriesResponse, PlatinumFirmDashboard, PlatinumAdvisorSummary, PlatinumClientSummary, PlatinumAccountSummary. Includes type guards and helper functions. LeaderboardEntry now has primary_role?: AdvisorRole (commit a30c403, 2026-04-14).

Distribution tab (2600+ lines). Dual-mode: Snapshot and Continuous. Cohort toggle: GEO / ADV / OFC (3-way — OFC added ADVI_OFFICE W3, commit 7dd0a7e portal DEV). Metric toggle: AUA / NNA (CLA removed). Snapshot: ApexCharts donut (lazy-loaded react-apexcharts), time machine strip (quarterly/annual periods), bell curve histogram (P10/P25/Median/P75/P90), drill-down (state->city for GEO, architect->client for ADV, office->advisor for OFC). NNA diverging colors at city/advisor drill level. Continuous: stacked area/bar chart (Recharts ComposedChart), hero metrics panel, window selector (1Y/3Y/Max), per-cohort series (geo/adv/ofc). NNA view uses diverging bar with net line overlay. OFC parity fixes (W6) pending (staged, DE task order). D5 (ADVI_FNTEND.B0, portal DEV 5ea017c): module-level `pseudonymizeChildLabel(key, cohort, isDrilled, ordinalMap)` forces `Client N` labels in Continuous-ADV drilled view (breadcrumb + hero + legend + tooltip). Stable per-drill-parent ordinal maps derived server-sorted from nna_adv_drill / adv_drill categories. Forced regardless of `canSeeCleartext()` — surface-specific, not role-gated. `(pseudonymized)` hero note also forced.

Advisors tab (1200+ lines). Unified all-roles leaderboard using PlatinumLeaderboardResponse (getFirmLeaderboard). Role filter checkboxes (architect/implementor/consultant/local_ops/additional_advisor), fee view filter (all/fee_paying/no_fee). Metric toggle: AUA/NNA/GRO. Window toggle: 3M/6M/1Y/2Y/3Y. Top 3 highlights panel (QTD/YTD/1Y/Max). Primary Type badge on each leaderboard card — AUA-dominant role from role_breakdown (commit a30c403, 2026-04-14 — fixes static priority bug). Click leaderboard card -> opens AdvisorPublicProfile inline drilldown (admin-gated by onAdvisorClick prop). Pinned bottom rows for 49F House and Unassigned.

Books tab (exported as BooksTab). Admin-gated (isFirmAdmin = isInternal() or isDev()). N1: AdvisorSummaryTable with 3d leaderboard-style card rows using PlatinumFirmDashboard. FeeEfficiencyPanel at N1 level. L2: AdvisorBookView (book overview for selected advisor). L3/L4 drill chain delegated to AdvisorBookClientDetail / AdvisorBookAccountDetail. Uses CanonicalBookView orchestrator for consistent panel layout at all levels.
LEGACY: Asset Intelligence tab. Cumulative NNA trend chart + snapshot table. Not wired into main page tab navigation (v5). Present but unreachable.
Fee Summary Panel for L3 (relationship) level. Left half of Row 3. Weighted avg fee headline + per-account fee table. Consumed by CanonicalBookView at L3.
Fee Role Breakdown Panel for L2 (advisor) level. Left half of Row 3. ApexCharts donut showing role AUA breakdown + role legend with fee bps per role. Consumed by CanonicalBookView at L2.

Fee Efficiency Panel for N1 (firm dashboard). Recharts scatter plot: NNA (X) vs Revenue (Y), dot size = AUA, color = growth rate. Replaces TaxCostBasisPanel at firm level. Consumed by ClientsTab/CanonicalBookView at N1.

Advisor drilldown view (ADVI_49PUSH .041). Inline panel rendered by AdvisorsTab on card click (admin). 2x2 layout: top-left Summary Card (identity + AUA + flows + fee), top-right Role Composition Donut (ApexCharts), bottom full-width timeseries (AUA stacked area by role | NNA diverging ComposedChart). Hero metrics panel + inflow/outflow bars + net line overlay (ADVI standard, commits fe81096 + 7628498). Data: getPlatinumAdvisorDrilldownSummary(advisorId) + getPlatinumAdvisorTimeseries(advisorId). Embedded AdvisorBookView for book-of-business drilldown.

Single-advisor book of business view. Owns L2 -> L3 -> L4 drill state chain. L2: book overview (ConsolidatedOverviewPanel + FeeRoleBreakdownPanel + ClientsTable). Delegates L3 to AdvisorBookClientDetail, L4 to AdvisorBookAccountDetail. Data: getAdvisorBook(advisorId), getBooksAdvisorComposition(advisorId), getAdvisorMixTimeseries().

L3 relationship detail view. Extracted from tabs/ClientsTab.tsx during ADVI_PROFIL.005. Client summary, accounts table, Mix+Concentration snapshot pies (linked selection), compact AUA/NNA composed chart, Tax Intelligence, Open Lots, Engagement. Data: getBooksClientDetail(clientKey), getBooksRelationshipComposition(relationshipId), getBooksRelationshipTimeseries(relationshipId), getPlatinumClientSummary(clientKey).

L4 account drill view. Pure renderer. Extracted from tabs/ClientsTab.tsx during ADVI_PROFIL.005. Inline slot inside AdvisorBookClientDetail. Account-scoped composition pies, compact timeseries, open lots. Data: getBooksAccountComposition(accountId), getBooksAccountTimeseries(accountId), getPlatinumAccountSummary(accountId).

Permanent header panel above all tabs. Donut chart (4+ views: AUA/NNA/GEO/ADV/OFC), time machine (quarterly snapshots), bell curve distribution, drill-down navigation, partner firm selector dropdown. Data from getPlatinumPartnerAnalytics() (prop passed from page).
Header metrics display (legacy). Total AUA, NNA periods, client counts, quarterly breakdowns. Largely superseded by PartnerAnalytics but file still present.
AUA composition donut/radial chart component. Used within PartnerAnalytics.
AUA trend stacked area chart. Rolling 12M NNA data visualization.
Dimension selector dropdown for grouping snapshot data (architect, region, tax_status, etc.).
Metric selector for NNA breakdown (NMNC, NMEC_NA, NMEC_SA, inflow, outflow, net).

Canonical dark-card tooltip wrapper for AdvisorIntelligence charts. Exports ChartTooltip shell, ChartTooltipRow (colored-bullet + label + value, optional sign-tint + emphasis), ChartTooltipDivider, ChartTooltipSubsection (e.g. Projected Period overlay). Matches PartnerAnalytics Assets Overview tooltip visual structure (border-white/10, SURFACE.tooltip bg, white/40 caption, structured rows). Consumers should compose body content from these primitives so every tooltip across the page is visually identical.

Canonical NNA diverging-bars + amber net-line ComposedChart primitive. Inflows blue (NNA_BAR.inflow #2196F3), Outflows red (NNA_BAR.outflow #EF4444), Net amber (NNA_BAR.net #F59E0B). Defaults height 360, accepts custom Y formatter + tooltip title + extra tooltip rows. netOnly mode renders single sign-tinted Net bar when gross data absent. Also exports NnaTooltipBody for charts that need to compose their own tooltip but want canonical Inflows/Outflows/Net rows. Consumed by AdvisorAnalytics NnaChart.
Barrel export for _shared/charts primitives.

Orchestrator that renders the canonical book framework at every drill level (N1 firm / L2 advisor / L3 client / L4 account). Routes to level-specific Row 3 layouts (FeeEfficiencyPanel at N1, FeeRoleBreakdownPanel at L2, FeeSummaryPanel at L3) while always rendering ConsolidatedOverviewPanel at Rows 1+2.
Canonical header panel used at every book drill level. Renders headline AUA/NNA/fee metrics, client/account counts, date range. Shared between BooksTab and AdvisorBookView.
Sorted client roster rows for L2 advisor book view. Extracted from ClientsTab.tsx (ADVI_PROFIL.005) so BooksTab (admin) and AdvisorBookView (non-admin profile) share the same renderer.
Cost basis and tax liability panel. Used at L3/L4 of book drilldown. Extracted from ClientsTab.tsx (ADVI_PROFIL.005) for sharing between BooksTab and AdvisorBookView.
Shared type aliases for canonical book panels (ConsolidatedOverviewPanel, TaxCostBasisPanel, CanonicalBookView). Extracted from ClientsTab.tsx during ADVI_PROFIL.005.
Pure composition helpers (no React imports). Extracted from ClientsTab.tsx (ADVI_PROFIL.005) for shared use by BooksTab and AdvisorBookView. Normalizes asset class mix, concentration data.
Legacy client detail drilldown page — individual client view with portfolio balance, AI summary, time series panels. Route: /advisor-intelligence/clients/:clientKey.
Barrel export for ClientDetailPage.
Client detail specific types (legacy).
AI-generated executive summary panel for individual client.
Portfolio balance visualization panel.
Time series chart panel for client AUA/NNA history.

100% stacked area chart (Recharts) showing asset class allocation over time. 5 series: equity, fixed_income, structured_notes, cash, other. 1Y/3Y/Max window toggle. Click area to filter selectedAssetClass. Fetches getMixTimeseries().
Top-N holdings stacked area chart over time. Filtered by selectedAssetClass when set. Fetches getConcentrationTimeseries(). "Top {top_n} Holdings" header from response.
Barrel export for client detail panels.

api_call.name: Platinum Partner Analytics
api_call.response_shape: PlatinumPartnerAnalyticsResponse: views { aua, nna, geo, adv, ofc, cla? } each with donut + distribution + metrics. Time machine periods.
api_call.file: AdvisorIntelligence.tsx (page-level fetch, prop to PartnerAnalytics + DistributionTab)

api_call.name: Platinum Cumulative Chart
api_call.response_shape: PlatinumCumulativeChartResponse: weekly-sampled geo/adv/ofc/nna timeseries. Replaces daily timeseries_chart.json (~7x smaller).

api_call.name: Firm Leaderboard (Platinum)
api_call.response_shape: PlatinumLeaderboardResponse: windows Record of PlatinumLeaderboardWindow. Each entry has role_breakdown: Record<string, PlatinumRoleBreakdown> with per-role AUA/NNA/fee partitions (fee_paying/no_fee sub-buckets added DS W6-005).

api_call.name: Platinum Advisor Drilldown Summary
api_call.response_shape: AdvisorDrilldownSummary: identity, role breakdown donut, headline AUA/NNA/fee metrics, role_composition.

api_call.name: Platinum Advisor Timeseries
api_call.response_shape: AdvisorTimeseriesResponse: array of AdvisorTimeseriesPoint { date, aua_by_role, inflows_canonical, outflows_canonical, nna_canonical }.

api_call.name: Advisor Book
api_call.response_shape: AdvisorBookResponse: summary, nna, growth, tax_exposure, income_fees, portfolio_composition, engagement, clients[].

api_call.name: Platinum Firm Dashboard
api_call.endpoint: /api/scoped/advisor-intelligence/platinum/firm/dashboard.json (split-mode fetches leaderboard + fee_efficiency + clients_tab in parallel)
api_call.response_shape: PlatinumFirmDashboard: leaderboard, fee_efficiency, clients_tab. Split mode issues sub-requests.

api_call.name: Advisor Fee Efficiency
api_call.response_shape: FeeEfficiencyResponse: scatter plot data points { name, nna, revenue, aua, growth_pct, advisor_id }.

api_call.name: Clients Tab (Book View)
api_call.response_shape: ClientsTabResponse: headline, tax, income_fees, portfolio, engagement, clients: ClientOption[].

api_call.name: Books Client Detail
api_call.response_shape: BooksClientDetailResponse: headline, tax, income_fees, portfolio, engagement, accounts[].

api_call.name: Books Relationship Composition
api_call.response_shape: BooksCompositionResponse: mix[], concentration { top_n, items, other }, unclassified.

api_call.name: Architect Leaderboard (LEGACY)
api_call.file: UNUSED in current AdvisorsTab — replaced by getFirmLeaderboard. May remain in ClientsTab legacy path.

api_call.name: Implementor Leaderboard (LEGACY)
api_call.file: UNUSED in current AdvisorsTab — replaced by getFirmLeaderboard.

api_call.name: Cumulative Chart (LEGACY)
api_call.file: LEGACY — replaced by getPlatinumCumulativeChart(). May still be referenced in AssetIntelligenceTab.

page_structure.tab: Dual-mode: Snapshot and Continuous. Cohort toggle: GEO / ADV / OFC (3-way; OFC added ADVI_OFFICE W3, portal DEV commit 7dd0a7e — not yet on PROD). Metric toggle: AUA / NNA (CLA removed). Snapshot: ApexCharts donut (lazy), time machine strip (quarterly/annual), bell curve histogram (P10/P25/P50/P75/P90), drill-down (state->city for GEO, architect->client for ADV, office->advisor for OFC). NNA diverging colors at city drill level (commit 3ae13c9). Continuous: Recharts ComposedChart stacked area + NNA diverging bars, window toggle (1Y/3Y/Max), hero metrics panel, legend. OFC continuous parity fixes pending (ADVI_OFFICE W6, DE staged). Window toggle grayed in Snapshot mode (commit 4d9f50e + 4150822).

Unified all-roles view using PlatinumLeaderboardResponse. Role filter checkboxes (5 roles, all checked by default). Fee view filter: All / Fee-Paying / No Fee. Metric toggle: AUA / NNA / GRO. Window toggle: 3M / 6M / 1Y / 2Y / 3Y. Top 3 highlights panel with QTD/YTD/1Y/Max selector. Leaderboard cards: Rank badge, Name, Primary Type badge (AUA-dominant role, commit a30c403), NNA, AUA, Growth%, New Clients. Click card -> opens AdvisorPublicProfile inline (admin-gated). Pinned bottom rows: 49F House, Unassigned (opacity-40, no drill).

Admin-gated (isFirmAdmin). N1 (firm dashboard): AdvisorSummaryTable + FeeEfficiencyPanel scatter plot. L2 (advisor): AdvisorBookView — book overview, FeeRoleBreakdownPanel, ClientsTable. L3 (client): AdvisorBookClientDetail — client summary, accounts, Mix+Concentration pies, compact AUA/NNA chart, tax intel, open lots, engagement. L4 (account): AdvisorBookAccountDetail — inline slot inside L3. All levels use CanonicalBookView orchestrator + ConsolidatedOverviewPanel for consistent layout.
Present as AssetIntelligenceTab.tsx but not wired into main page tab navigation (v5). Unreachable from UI.

lifecycle_and_state.state_management: Page-level: React Query (TanStack Query) for getPlatinumPartnerAnalytics. AdvisorsTab: React Query (getFirmLeaderboard). Local state for role filter, fee view, metric, window, selectedAdvisorId (drill), sort, search. DistributionTab: Local state for viewStyle, cohort (geo/adv/ofc), metric (aua/nna), timePeriod, drill keys (selectedStateKey, selectedCityKey, selectedArchitectKey, selectedClientKey, selectedOfficeKey), window. React Query for getPlatinumCumulativeChart. ClientsTab: React Query for getPlatinumFirmDashboard. Local state for drill hierarchy. AdvisorPublicProfile: React Query for advisor drilldown summary + timeseries. All S3 static files via portal-proxy (CloudFront -> S3 opal-data-portal-v2).
lifecycle_and_state.data_flow: 1. Page mounts -> getPlatinumPartnerAnalytics fires -> PartnerAnalytics header renders 2. Distribution tab mounts -> getPlatinumCumulativeChart fires 3. Advisors tab mounts -> getFirmLeaderboard fires 4. Books tab mounts -> getPlatinumFirmDashboard fires (split mode: leaderboard + fee_efficiency + clients_tab) 5. Advisor card click -> selectedAdvisorId set -> AdvisorPublicProfile renders with getPlatinumAdvisorDrilldownSummary + getPlatinumAdvisorTimeseries 6. Drill-down: OFC/GEO/ADV cohort click -> nested drill state updated -> donut segments + bell curve update 7. Time machine: click period strip -> timePeriod state updates -> historical snapshot renders

known_limitations.limitation: OFC cohort on portal DEV only (ADVI_OFFICE W3, commit 7dd0a7e). W6 DE parity fixes staged. W8 DT deploy pending after W5+W6+W7.
AssetIntelligenceTab.tsx present but not wired into tab navigation (v5).
getCumulativeChart and getArchitectLeaderboard/getImplementorLeaderboard remain in endpoints file but are no longer consumed by current AdvisorsTab/DistributionTab — replaced by platinum endpoints.
All data refreshed daily by bd-portal-publisher and bd-portal-advisor-publisher Lambdas. No real-time updates.
ClientsTab and Books admin gate: isFirmAdmin = isInternal() or isDev(). External firm admins cannot access Books tab.
